items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: I like the way Lewis played it behind Chippy Hill.

ctx.x: See I'm telling you, people used to let the singer say what they gonna say, then you come in with some pretty stuff behind her. But now, looks like that Trouble in Mind. I didn't make it, but I like the way Lewis played it behind Chippy Hill. She had a one eye, Trouble in Mind. She really put a record out on that. Lewis played about, he played a whole course before she come in. Whole course.
